query:
UPDATE company
        SET
            name             = COALESCE($1, name),
            contact_email    = COALESCE($2, contact_email),
            phone            = COALESCE($3, phone),
            shipping_address = COALESCE($4, shipping_address),
            active           = COALESCE($5, active)
        WHERE id = $6
        RETURNING
            id               AS "id!: Uuid",
            name             AS "name!",
            contact_email,
            phone,
            shipping_address,
            active           AS "active!",
            created_at       AS "created_at!: DateTime<Utc>"
